title: Core 12-Woman #33
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, twelve women in a single row.

A photograph of TWELVE women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 12 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render. Exactly 12 women, no more, no fewer.

Left to right:
[Egyptian Glam / Legend Bust]: Egyptian woman, early 30s, cool and composed, warm golden-bronze skin, sharp winged kohl liner, a deep terracotta-red lip, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in low bun, oval nails (matte). an upper body dominated entirely by one mythologically enormous bust, far wider than her own shoulders, the defining feature. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Japanese Kutani porcelain (a cream-white ground with bold red, gold and green overglaze enamels), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Piercings: 5pc clicker rings/a mix of diamonds, pearls and sapphires/rose-gold/asym. Jewellery: well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of mixed-metal a hair ornament. Pose: kneeling on both knees, facing camera. Shoes: extreme gold-and-red extreme platform square-toe heels.

Painted in Portuguese azulejo tile (a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Piercings: 15pc bars/pearls/mixed metal/asym. Jewellery: well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of rose-gold a necklace. Pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward. Shoes: extreme cobalt platform stiletto peep-toe heels.

[Balkan glam / Heavy Muscle]: Romanian woman, late 20s, cheerful, warm fair-olive skin, thick dark straight-edged brows, a heavy black liner smoked out at the outer corners, deep brown shadow blended up to the crease, long dense lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour, a deep red matte lip with a crisp edge, an intense, proud expression, soft champagne-blonde hair styled in cornrows braided tight against the scalp, square nails (chrome). massive thick arms, broad muscular back, huge chest, dense muscular torso and legs with only a soft hint of a waist. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, every woman an extraordinarily large woman far beyond any real person, generous horizontal spacing so every figure reads clearly and large. Exactly 12 women total.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 12, catching each woman's own painted pattern and piercings distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 16:9 landscape 8K.
